notFound.title: No review with this ID in your facilities
notFound.description: Check the link, or open the review from the review queue.

denied.body: This review belongs to a facility outside your current scope. The attempt was recorded in the audit trail.

flag.label: Flag for review
flag.heading: Why this screening was flagged

summary.DEMO_BP_SYSTOLIC_AT_OR_ABOVE_THRESHOLD: Systolic reading at or above the demo threshold configured in ruleset {{version}}.
summary.DEMO_BP_DIASTOLIC_AT_OR_ABOVE_THRESHOLD: Diastolic reading at or above the demo threshold configured in ruleset {{version}}.
summary.DEMO_GLUCOSE_AT_OR_ABOVE_THRESHOLD: Blood glucose at or above the demo threshold for its fasting status configured in ruleset {{version}}.
summary.GLUCOSE_UNIT_MISSING: A glucose value was recorded without a unit, so ruleset {{version}} could not evaluate it — a person must review it.
summary.GLUCOSE_CONTEXT_NOT_RECORDED: Fasting status was not recorded; ruleset {{version}} used its placeholder for an unknown status.
summary.notEvaluable: Required inputs were incomplete, so ruleset {{version}} could not evaluate this screening — it was routed to a person.

flag.rulesetChipHint: Show the rules of this demo ruleset
flag.disclaimer: A flag is a prompt for clinician review — it is not a diagnosis.

rulesetModal.title: Demo ruleset {{version}}
rulesetModal.description: The illustrative rules that flag screenings in this demo. Their values are placeholders — not clinically validated and not approved by any clinical authority.
rulesetModal.unknown: This ruleset version is not available in this demo, so its rules cannot be listed.

rules.BP-1: Systolic blood pressure is compared with the demo systolic threshold.
rules.BP-2: Diastolic blood pressure is compared with the demo diastolic threshold.
rules.GLU-1: Blood glucose (converted to mmol/L) is compared with the demo threshold for its fasting status.
rules.GLU-2: A glucose value needs a unit; without one it is not evaluated and goes to a person.
rules.GLU-3: Fasting status should be recorded; when it is not, the demo placeholder for an unknown status is used.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.subtitle: Inputs as captured at flag time, compared with demo ruleset {{version}}.
evidence.caption: Evidence inputs and their demo rule status
evidence.noRule: No demo rule evaluates this input
evidence.amendedAfterFlag: Evidence amended after flag — see correction history
evidence.amendedAfterFlagBody: The screening was corrected after this flag was raised. The evidence above is the snapshot taken at flag time and is never changed.
evidence.empty: No evidence captured — cannot be reviewed; contact data quality

howToRead.title: How to read this
howToRead.body: A flag is a prompt for a clinician to look at this screening. It is not a diagnosis and does not recommend treatment. The demo rules use placeholder values that are not clinically validated — use your clinical judgement and the full record.

prior.empty: No screenings recorded for this patient.

provenance.title: Source and provenance
